heading: Purpose of HLD
content: Purpose of HLDThe High Level Design Document (HLD) is the single solution document created during a project. It contains solution summary, architectural information and solution details that are used as an input for development and testing activities.

content:

heading: 1.3 Solution Summary
content: 1.3 Solution SummaryAmazon Quick Sight is data visualization and analysis component of Amazon Quick. Amazon Connect data lake is centralized repository for data generated by Amazon Connect and Amazon Quick Sight is BI tool which will help build dashboard for day2 operation. In short, the amazon connect data lake is single source for all connect data with zero-ETL (i.e no complex data pipeline need to be maintained). This is quickset and fastest way to build dashboard for connect.The AWS Data export will allow export of CUR 2.0 report to a S3 bucket, which can be visualized using Athena and Amazon Quick Sight. In other words, Athena can query data (S3) to create dashboard for Business using Amazon Quick Sight.  Provide links and version dates to the additional documents listed below.DocumentLocationDateVersionRequirements Matrix (RM)Including the IT responses to requirements*Requirements - All DocumentsCyber STARRTBDUse CaseRequirements - All DocumentsHLD v1 (Non-PCI)HLD version 1HLD v1 (PCI)HLD version 1 (PCI)

heading: 2.7 Security Architecture
content: 2.7 Security Architecture<<For ICSU to provide approval, the accompanying CyberSTARR Jira ticket number must be completed and accessible>>Architecture Overview:This is update to architecture released for CCR release v1.0 [High Level Design - Contact Center Re-Platform - MVP (non-PCI)#2.7.1SolutionArchitectureView]. The key update is integration Amazon Quick Sight to Amazon Connect customer. The Amazon Connect Customer Data Lake is AWS created and Managed resource and Amazon Connect Customer uses AWS RAM to shares its data tables to other account / roles / users. AWS RAM help us share data across OU / Accounts using IAM. AWS RAM reduces operational overhead, provides security and visibility at scale. It also supports resource-based policy. The Amazon Connect Customer data in PCI account (Owning/Sharing account) will share the data to non-PCI account (Consuming Account) where Quick Sight & Athena shall be provisioned.  AWS RAM is PCI-DSS compliant, however there is no data share (tables) has PCI data.See the one time process for enabling Access of DataLake to Amazon Quick Sight user 2.4.1.1.1EnablingQuicksightforAmazonConnectSee the list of data table which will be shared 2.4.1.1DatatabletobesharedbyConnecttoAthena%2BQuickSight
